1. In order to bring only EMIB Die records,  join the ITEM_ID in "IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_DIE_CONSUMPTION_ROOT " with ITEM_ID in "IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_CHARACTERISTIC_DENORMALIZED_CORE_PIT". Only when the below metadata is satisfied.  In the matched records, , filter records when  "DESIGNED_FUNCTION_CODE" column value of IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_CHARACTERISTIC_DENORMALIZED_CORE_PIT is equal to the value  fetched the value from COLUMN_VALUE_TWO_TXT from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM_BASE.T_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_CURRENT where SubjectAreaNm = 'EMIBDIE', EntityNm = 'EMIB', BusinessRuleNm = 'EMIB' and COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT ="DESIGNED_FUNCTION_CODE". If not, it should be marked as Fallout(DQ).

2. To derive PLANT_CD, map the MANUFACTURING_LOCATION_ID fromIF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_DIE_CONSUMPTION_ROOT and join the withe MANUFACTURING_LOCATION_CD column from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_PLANT_CODE_MAPPING_CORE_PIT, the corresponding PLANT_CD will be PLANT_CD.
